cycles.title: Refutation sweep — projection closure, completeness, and hidden universality
cycles.objective: Attack existing hypotheses rather than generate new ones, seeking decisive contradictions, vacuous quantifiers, hidden general computation, and newly applicable lower bounds.
actions: Proved a closure lemma for existential forgetting in DNNF.
Combined the closure lemma with explicit exponential DNNF lower bounds to destroy H016.
Constructed a vacuous algorithm satisfying the written H018 clauses while deciding nothing, forcing terminal rejection of the formulation.
Audited H009 and H017 for computational universality hidden in finite local rewrite systems.
Audited H010 against finite-field and strong extension-rule polynomial-calculus lower bounds.
Audited H019 for underspecified interface semantics.
Rechecked H014 and H015 against current 2025-2026 primary literature.
Added append-only terminal shadowing so historical cycle files remain immutable.
discoveries: Projected auxiliary variables do not protect H016 from lower bounds against ordinary DNNF because DNNF supports linear-size forgetting.
The previous A036 defence for H016 considered deterministic succinctness only and was insufficient against an all-DNNF lower bound.
H018's one-way accepting-path condition was vacuous without quotient coverage and two-sided decision correctness.
Locality is not itself a complexity restriction; a useful local mechanism requires a preserved invariant or a proved non-universality property.
cycles.claim_boundary: C004 proves no statement about P versus NP. It decisively retires one false representation conjecture and one malformed algorithmic formulation; all other outcomes are weakening or survival under the recorded attacks.
next_cycle: Formalize a corrected descendant of H018 only after defining complete quotient coverage and rejection certificates.
Search for a representation-closure argument against H019's interface DAG language.
Restrict H009 and H017 by an explicit invariant that makes local-rule universality impossible.
Sharpen H010 so that known extension-variable lower bounds either apply or expose the exact remaining gap.
